name: vertigo-title-sequence
title: Vertigo Title Sequence
description: Homage to Saul Bass and Alfred Hitchcock: Opening eye close-up, stark monochrome spirals, and bold typographic title reveal.

shots.title: The Gaze
shots.caption: A stark, high-contrast close-up of a woman's face and piercing gaze, bathed in monochrome and deep technicolor noir crimson.

shots.title: The Vortex
shots.caption: The camera penetrates the pupil, dissolving reality into stark black-and-white graphic forms. Hypnotic Whitney Spirograph spirals expand outward.

shots.title: The Title
shots.caption: The vortex draws the eye relentlessly toward the center before the bold, stark title 'VERTIGO' appears with kinetic offset.
